description: Summarise a project's comments into themes ranked by severity, open questions, and a self-contained implementation brief for a coding agent. Read the brief before proposing changes instead of reasoning over raw comments. The brief leaves out work an open question holds up; `answers` says which are answered, so ask the user the rest. Shared with the dashboard: an unchanged comment set returns the saved digest instantly.

force.description: Regenerate even when the comments have not changed since the saved digest was written. Costs a model call; leave unset.

scope.description: Which comments to cover: open (new + reviewed, the default), new, resolved (resolved + dismissed), or all

name: summarise_feedback

answers.description: Open questions already answered in the dashboard.

cached.description: True when the saved digest was reused rather than regenerated.

coverage.description: Comments the digest read out of those in scope. included below total means only the most recent were read; say so when reporting it.

headline.description: One sentence on what this round of feedback is mostly about.

implementation_prompt.description: Self-contained brief to hand to a coding agent, rewritten around any answers.

open_questions.description: Decisions a person has to make. Ask the user the unanswered ones rather than guessing.

blocks.description: Titles of the themes this question holds up.

title: Summarise comments
